records.Entity / project type: ASIC and Bitcoin mining machine manufacturer
records.Concise description: MicroBT is the manufacturer behind the WhatsMiner family of SHA-256 Bitcoin mining machines.
records.Deeper researched summary: Shenzhen MicroBT Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. designs WhatsMiner ASIC mining systems and current 2026 support/product materials cover its M7x-generation and earlier machines. The registry keeps MicroBT and WhatsMiner together because the company/manufacturer and flagship hardware family are one integrated canonical identity, while individual M-series devices remain child models.
records.Launch / history: MicroBT was founded in 2016 and became a major competitor in industrial Bitcoin ASIC hardware.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: WhatsMiner is one of the few durable large-scale ASIC platforms and is necessary for a representative manufacturer-level mining hardware canon.
Important technical or cultural characte: Air, hydro and immersion variants by model family
Manufacturer-level profile, not one record per M-series device
Firmware/control behavior can differ by generation
records.Verification basis: Current manufacturer-controlled product and support materials verify active 2026 hardware production and the MicroBT/WhatsMiner identity.
Research notes / uncertainties: Tie performance/efficiency claims to specific models and firmware versions if later published.

records.Entity / project type: ASIC and Bitcoin mining machine manufacturer
records.Concise description: Canaan is an early Bitcoin ASIC pioneer and the manufacturer of the Avalon mining machine family.
records.Deeper researched summary: Canaan’s Avalon lineage reaches back to the first wave of commercial Bitcoin ASIC miners and remains active with current Avalon product generations in 2026. The canonical profile covers the company, ASIC design lineage, and Avalon family while leaving individual machine SKUs as child products rather than separate Explore entities.
records.Launch / history: Avalon hardware emerged in the 2013 ASIC transition; Canaan remains an active mining-hardware manufacturer in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: Canaan connects the historical transition from FPGA/GPU mining to application-specific hardware with a still-active modern manufacturer.
records.Verification basis: Current Canaan site and product catalog verify active Avalon manufacturing and company identity.
Research notes / uncertainties: Avoid unqualified 'first ASIC miner' superlatives unless tied to the precise product/date/source wording.
Efficiency figures must remain model- and date-specific.

records.Concise description: Auradine’s Teraflux line is a newer U.S.-based Bitcoin mining hardware platform with current ASIC systems, FluxOS software, and grid/demand-response control features.
records.Deeper researched summary: Auradine, founded in 2022, develops Teraflux Bitcoin mining systems and associated FluxOS controls. Current 2026 manuals and software updates show an actively supported platform. Auradine also markets EnergyTune and grid-program integrations that allow miners to adjust power draw; MSC should describe the control capability and documented partnerships without repeating broad claims that mining automatically stabilizes grids.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2022; Teraflux systems entered market during the 2020s and remained actively supported in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: It adds meaningful hardware competition and a technically explicit demand-response/control layer without requiring a separate profile for every Teraflux miner.
records.Verification basis: Current Auradine product/support materials verify active Teraflux systems, FluxOS updates, and power-control features.
Research notes / uncertainties: Grid-service outcomes depend on contracts, market conditions, and operator behavior; do not convert vendor claims into universal grid-benefit statements.

records.Entity / project type: integrated Bitcoin mining hardware and software platform
records.Concise description: Block’s Proto mining platform combines a modular ASIC mining rig, custom mining silicon, fleet-management software, and an open Mining Development Kit.
records.Deeper researched summary: Proto is modeled as one integrated mining platform rather than separate profiles for Block, Proto Rig, Fleet, individual chips, and the Mining Development Kit. The platform’s current materials emphasize modularity and field serviceability, while Block/Core Scientific announcements document commercial deployment of Proto hardware. Proto’s open MDK provides a distinct hardware-development surface for mining system builders.
Creators / founders: Thomas Templeton — Block hardware lead associated with Proto program
records.Launch / history: Block began publicly developing Bitcoin mining silicon in the early 2020s; Proto branding and commercial rig deployment expanded in 2025–2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: It is a major new entrant attempting to change ASIC hardware serviceability, supply competition, and open development tooling.

Corroborating sources.label: Block investor release — Proto Rig and Proto Fleet deployment

records.Verification basis: Current Proto product materials plus customer deployment announcements verify an active commercial mining-hardware platform.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not treat all Proto roadmap claims as deployed hardware; distinguish shipping/deployed products from announced development plans.
